description: This source file is a shell script that initializes and manages a network protocol called MBIM within the OpenWRT environment. It defines functions for setting up, configuring, and tearing down the MBIM protocol, including device handling, network registration, IP configuration, and interaction with other system components.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the MBIM protocol.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific fields from the MBIM configuration output.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM protocol, attempts to initialize the network interface.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down or disconnects the MBIM network interface.
